thread:
Priya S.: Hey team — can someone take a quick look at PR #4921? It's in snowflake/ddl: adds `user_tier` column + a backfill job. Planning to apply during the maintenance window tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need one infra + one analytics approval before merge. CI passed locally but would appreciate a schema/migration safety check. Link: https://git.redwood/pr/4921 :hands:

Dan H.: Thanks — dropping by to review. Can you paste the ALTER statement and confirm whether this is additive/backwards-compatible? Also any expected locks/downtime?

Priya S.: Sure — here's the ALTER we plan to run on prod:```ALTER TABLE analytics.users ADD COLUMN user_tier VARCHAR(16) NULL;```Backfill runs after in batches:```python scripts/backfills/add_user_tier_backfill.py --batch-size 10k --dry-run=false```Plan is nullable add first (no lock beyond metadata), then background backfill over a few hours. Default for new rows is set at application layer to "free" during rollout.

Morgan L.: Quick q — how big is the table (rows, typical partitions)? If backfill touches a lot of micro-batches we should shard the backfill by created_at and run staggered jobs. Also recommend gating the feature with FF so reads don't depend on backfill immediately.

Priya S.: Table ~220M rows, partitioned by day. Backfill estimated ~3–4 hours based on staging run (see below). We'll run the backfill in 1h windows per partition and limit concurrency. Feature flag `user_tier_rollout` will be off until backfill completes for last 30 days.

Alex R.: Can you add the query plan / explain for the backfill and an estimated max IO/compute? SRE wants to ensure this won't spike our warehouse credit usage. Also please add a rollback plan (how to revert if something goes sideways).

Priya S.: Uploaded staging run logs and explain: https://ci.redwood/builds/4921/staging-run.log — staging showed avg 120k rows/min with our batching. Estimated credits ~1.2k for full backfill. Rollback: stop backfill job + set app to fallback to previous code path (FF off). We also have a snapshot of the table taken earlier today (vault:/snapshots/users-2026-03-15).

ci-bot: CI pipeline for PR #4921 — all checks passed ✅ (unit tests, lint, migration-checks).

Dan H.: Looks good to me from infra side. One nit about the backfill script retry behavior (we should cap retries). Other than that :+1: Approving now. @priya — ping me right before merge.

Morgan L.: Reviewed analytics side — only suggestion is to add an idempotency key to the backfill job logs so we can resume cleanly per partition. Once that's added I'm happy to approve.

Priya S.: Will add idempotency keys and reduce retries. I'll push a follow-up patch within the hour. Thanks for the fast reviews.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window tonight 22:00-23:30 UTC. Please post runbook link and CI + snapshot links in thread before merge.

Priya S.: Updated PR with idempotency keys and retry cap. New commit pushed. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/snowflake-ddl-apply. Snapshot + CI links are above. Planning to merge and run ALTER at 22:00 UTC; backfill to start 22:15 UTC. Will @channel the oncall and DM @Dan H. before merge.

Morgan L.: Approved.

Dan H.: Approved. Merge when ready. :thumbsup:

Priya S.: Thanks all — merging at 22:00 UTC and will post a short post-mortem if anything unexpected shows up. Will ping #oncall during the window. :rocket:
